notes.title: Free starting June 11th
notes.content:
Jgsw will be free forever starting June 11th!

Why? It has been 2 years since I released Jgsw as my first independant project. It has been hugely formative in my professional career as a game developer and I am so proud of the product I created. Jgsw is not a commercial success but the little bit I've made from it over the past 2 years has helped me a lot. There are tons of other jigsaw puzzle games out there on Steam and elsewhere. I hope I made a unique experience that people can continue to enjoy, now free. There are no updates planned.

Thank you to the people who have supported it with their wallet: I made it to a place in my life where I don't need to charge for the game anymore.

Thank you to the people who give the game a try: this is the part that means a lot to me now.
